verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity provides building blocks for background automation, but the user has to build and host the automation logic themselves. Documented pieces include webhook events on every session status change so an integration can "automatically trigger reactions", a blocklist that programmatically blocks future verifications, reusable verification flows with static links, and an MCP server agents can use against the Stripe API. Missing for 10: a native, user-configurable automation or scheduled-job feature that runs inside the product, documentation of autonomous agent-driven workflows specific to Identity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of background automation.
